news.title: 'Italian opposition fragmented: No alternative leader, no other possible leader than Giorgia Meloni'
news.summary: Alison Sargent is pleased to welcome Political analyst Lorenzo Pregliasco, co-founder of polling agency YouTrend and adjunct professor at the University of Bologna. He argues that Giorgia Meloni’s unusual longevity in office is best understood not simply as a record of political strength, but as the product of a carefully calibrated governing strategy. Meloni has maintained stability partly by avoiding structural reforms disruptive enough to mobilize multiple constituencies against her at once. Her dominance within Fratelli d’Italia, the absence of a credible alternative leader, and a fragmented opposition have reinforced that advantage.

news.title: Strength of Meloni less linked to policy, more about her party's dominance within govt coalition
news.summary: William Hilderbrandt is pleased to welcome Dr. Giulia Sandri, Associate researcher at the Free University of Brussels. Meloni has benefited from something historically scarce in Italian politics: longevity. Four years of governmental stability have allowed her to accumulate diplomatic relationships, strengthening Italy’s position within Europe and giving Rome greater visibility internationally. Yet Sandri argues that this political success sits alongside a much less decisive domestic record. Improvements in employment and fiscal credibility coexist with weak growth, stagnant wages, declining purchasing power and persistent structural problems in healthcare, education, demographics and public administration.

news.title: Unearthing her story: The rise of women archaeologists

At the same time, advances in technology – from DNA analysis to carbon dating – are allowing archaeologists to build a far more accurate picture of the past. And sometimes, that means questioning assumptions that have existed for generations.

news.summary: This week, FRANCE 24's media show Scoop looks at the murder of anti-corruption journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia. Press freedom groups are furious after Maltese businessman Yorgen Fenech was acquitted of involvement. Caruana Galizia was an outspoken critic of the government and described as a "one-woman WikiLeaks". She was killed by a car bomb in 2017 and speculation followed that influential figures may have been involved. Our guest is the Times of Malta Editor-in-Chief, Herman Grech.

news.title: 'Worst possible timing': Farage's Reform UK meets as new donation scandal hits
news.summary: British hard-right leader Nigel Farage's Reform UK party gathered for its annual conference on Friday engulfed by a fresh scandal. Just hours before Farage's address, two senior Reform officials resigned following an undercover investigation aired by Channel 4 News that alleged they had conspired to secure a foreign donation – barred under UK electoral law. The conference will also be addressed by Jordan Bardella, president of France's far-right National Rally party. FRANCE 24's Senior Reporter Clovis Casali tells us more.

news.title: Body of world's youngest traditional king returns home to Uganda amid succession row
news.summary: King Oyo died in the US last week aged 34 after receiving treatment for an aggressive form of cancer.

news.title: 1,8 milhão trabalhavam por meio de plataformas digitais em 2025
news.summary: Segundo os dados divulgados pelo IBGE nesta 6ª feira (4.set), 1 milhão atuava no transporte particular de passageiros

news.title: Trump's White House releases deportation video games
news.summary: US President Donald Trump's White House on Thursday unveiled a website featuring classic arcade games – but with a "MAGA" twist, in which players can deport migrants and build a border wall. Rights groups swiftly criticised the release of the online games, which comes as the Trump administration steps up its mass arrest and deportation program for undocumented migrants.

news.title: PF diz que Mendonça sugeriu benefício ilegal a empresário
news.summary: Relatório divulgado por Moraes cita atuação do ministro em negociação de delação

news.title: US envoys headed to Russia and Ukraine to relaunch mediation
news.summary: The return of Washington's negotiators raises hope of progress towards a settlement to end Moscow's war on Ukraine.

news.title: Fachin tira investigação contra Mendonça do inquérito das fake news
news.summary: Ministro Alexandre Moraes pediu que o colega de Corte seja investigado após levantar sigilo de relatório da Polícia Federal

news.title: Trump raises doubts over support for Britain in Falklands dispute with Argentina
news.summary: US President Donald Trump raised doubts about whether the United States would support Britain in another conflict over the Falkland Islands in an interview with a British broadcaster aired Thursday, injecting new tension into the long-standing dispute over the British-controlled archipelago also claimed by Argentina. Trump's comments came as his ideological ally, Argentine President Javier Milei, prepared to deliver a televised national address about what his government has described as diplomatic progress over the islands that lie about 480 kilometers off Argentina’s coast in the South Atlantic. FRANCE 24's International Affairs Editor Rochelle Ferguson-Bouyahe tells us more.

news.title: France announces €1 billion aid for farmers recovering from drought, heatwaves
news.summary: France on Friday allocated more than €1 billion in aid to support farmers recovering from droughts after a brutal, record-breaking summer. The allocation includes €520 million for rapid payments to ‌help farmers deal with weather damage and a €235 million recovery ​fund to buy seeds, plants and ​animal feed, Agriculture Minister Annie Genevard said.

news.title: UK reasserts Falklands sovereignty amid Milei claim and Trump comments
news.summary: Britain insisted Friday that the Falkland Islands "are British" after Argentine President Javier Milei suggested the "winds of change" now favoured his country's claim to the archipelago, citing Washington's readiness to reconsider its neutrality in the dispute. The islands' fate returned to the headlines after US President Donald Trump threatened to wade into the dispute, while a British-Israeli oil project near the islands stoked anger in Argentina. FRANCE 24's London correspondent, Bénédicte Paviot, gives an inside look at Downing Street's reaction to these developments.

news.title: Israeli minister unveils plan to remove Gaza's population over seven years
news.summary: Israel's far-right National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir set out a plan on Thursday to remove Palestinians from the Gaza Strip and send them abroad. Speaking in the run-up to close-fought Israeli elections, he said the plan aimed to see the departure of 250,000 Palestinians from Gaza in the first year, followed by the rest of the roughly two million residents over the following six years. Forced displacement of civilians in occupied territory is considered a war crime under the Geneva Conventions.

news.title: As the China-US AI race reaches Cairo, Egypt faces a strategic decision
news.summary: Egypt walks a tightrope as China and the US vie for dominance in AI data centre development.

news.title: Rusia rebaja las expectativas de avances para la paz antes de la reunión con los enviados de Trump
news.summary: Las autoridades rusas han rebajado este viernes las expectativas de lograr avances para el fin de la guerra en Ucrania antes de la cita prevista con los enviados del presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, que mantendrán una reunión en Moscú antes de desplazarse a Ucrania, en plenos intentos de revitalizar el proceso trilateral.

news.title: 'Moroccans are desperate: Years of political crackdown and lack of economic opportunities'
news.summary: François Picard is pleased to welcome Aida Alami, New York Times World contributor. Drawing on her own field reporting at the Moroccan border, Alami challenges attempts to explain the mass crossing primarily through a theory of deliberate state orchestration. While acknowledging both Morocco’s history of leveraging migration in its relations with Spain and the possibility that security forces made tactical decisions on the day, Alami insists on distinguishing evidence from inference. Her reporting instead points toward an interaction between online misinformation, overwhelmed security forces, and a population already primed to migrate by political repression and limited economic opportunity.

news.title: Irán reclama a EEUU que "acepte los hechos" y "retire" a sus militares desplegados en Oriente Próximo
news.summary: El Ejército de Irán ha reclamado este viernes a Estados Unidos que "acepte los hechos" derivados del conflicto abierto por su ofensiva conjunta con Israel contra el país asiático y "se retire de la región", reiterando así su exigencia de que las tropas estadounidenses abandonen Oriente Próximo.

news.title: Rusia acusa a Alemania de un doble rasero por su reacción al incidente en Leipzig y el sabotaje al Nord Stream
news.summary: El Kremlin ha reiterado este viernes su rechazo a las acusaciones de Alemania en torno al ataque fallido contra el aeropuerto de Leipzig (este) y ha criticado a Berlín por lo que ha descrito como una doble vara de medir respecto a este incidente y el sabotaje contra el gasoducto Nord Stream, que Moscú achaca a las autoridades de Ucrania.

news.title: Haute Couture, autumn-winter 2026/27: Make way for the independent labels
news.summary: Some couturiers get to modernise houses owned by luxury groups. Among them is Duran Lantink, who draws on Jean Paul Gaultier's ballet-costume era for his inspiration. Independent houses, by contrast, must create from scratch. Iris van Herpen turns to science. Rahul Mishra finds inspiration in the beauty of Hindu goddesses. Imane Ayissi pays tribute to his late mother. Finally, Kevin Germanier keeps celebrating the most desirable approach to recycling imaginable.

news.title: US state of Louisiana in battle over electoral map
news.summary: With just two months to go before the US midterm elections, the battle for votes is in full swing. Our reporter Fanny Allard has been to the state of Louisiana, where a redistricting row is playing out with far-reaching implications for racial equality.

news.title: India’s Smriti Mandhana becomes top run-scorer in women’s cricket
news.summary: Mandhana overtook former India captain Mithali Raj, who had been the top international scorer with 10,868 runs.

news.title: ONU aprova resolução para corrigir representação do mundo nos mapas
news.summary: Modelo amplamente utilizado remonta ao Século 16; ele contém distorção que amplia massas de terra mais distantes da linha do Equador e reduz regiões como África, América Latina e Sul da Ásia; proposta, que recebeu 164 votos favoráveis, se baseia em dados científica e reparação histórica.

news.title: Apelo de US$ 49,6 milhões quer socorrer afetados por inundações no Nepal
news.summary: ONU lança pedido de emergência para socorrer mais de 84 mil vítimas de tragédia, que já deixou mais de 1,3 mil mortos e milhares de desaparecidos; em cenário de mais de 40 pontes destruídas, voos de helicóptero se tornaram único meio de abastecer localidades isoladas.

news.summary: Movimento de armas, tecnologia militar e apoio logístico são fornecidos às partes em conflito; grupo independente recolheu indícios sobre a ação destes grupos a partir de países como Colômbia e Emirados Árabes Unidos.

news.title: Unaids lidera aliança sino-africana na indústria farmacêutica
news.summary: Pela soberania sanitária, iniciativa mobiliza investimentos e inovação para impulsionar produção local de medicamentos e diagnósticos na África Austral; plano visa romper com a dependência externa de insumos médicos e democratizar acesso a tratamentos essenciais, incluindo resposta ao HIV.

news.title: Timor-Leste elimina tracoma e fortalece vigilância sanitária
news.summary: Após anos de estudos epidemiológicos, país recebeu validação internacional pela eliminação do tracoma, tornando-se referência em saúde ocular no Sudeste Asiático; resultado fortalece políticas de saneamento e amplia compromisso com meta global de erradicar a doença até 2030.

news.summary: The comments come as Argentinian president Javier Milei says the "winds of change" favoured his country's claim on the British overseas territory.

news.title: Mass burial reveals hidden toll of Algeria’s deadly ‘Black Wednesday’ wildfires
news.summary: Wildfires ripped across northeastern Algeria in late August. Photos and videos showing the mass burial of several dozen people have raised questions about the real death toll of the fires as Algerian authorities haven’t shared new numbers since August 26. A number of Moroccan social media accounts have also been sharing disinformation about the fires.

news.title: Trump asks SCOTUS to OK changes to mail-in ballots. And, diesel prices hit record high
news.summary: Trump has asked the Supreme Court to lift the block on his plan for the USPS to restrict mail voting ahead of the midterm elections. And, diesel prices have reached a record high.

news.title: Meloni celebra que su Gobierno es el más longevo de la historia y reivindica la coalición de derechas
